questions.question: Why did the LORD tell the prophet Jeremiah that He would bring disaster on Judah and Jerusalem?

answers.text: They abandoned Him for other gods
They lost a battle to Egypt
They broke a treaty with Babylon

questions.question: The LORD said He would shatter Jerusalem like a potter's jar. What did He say about that jar?

answers.text: It can never again be repaired
Its pieces will be kept as a sign
A better jar will replace it

questions.question: The LORD told Jeremiah that burning children in the fire as offerings to Baal was something He never commanded. True or false?
When the LORD sent Jeremiah to break a clay jar, who did He tell him to bring along?

answers.text: Some elders and leaders of the priests
The gatekeepers and the temple singers
The king and his royal officials
